svg.aria-label: Porchlight — a lit porch lantern over the PORCHLIGHT wordmark. A departed member's exit-interview quote is matched by meaning to the creator's fix, a glowing thread links them through the lantern, the member returns, and recovered MRR ticks $95 to $105 per month.

g.text: Remembers why members leave — wins them back when it’s fixed.
